routes.name: Somalia eVisa (ETAS)
routes.summary: Apply online at etas.gov.so before travel. Upload documents, pay the fee, get approval by email and show it on arrival.

other: Fees, validity and categories not published on pages read. Contact info@immigration.gov.so.

sources.label: Somalia Embassy Washington: how to apply for eVisa

steps: Fill in the form at etas.gov.so
Wait for email approval and carry a copy

routes.name: Short-Stay Entry Visa (embassy)
routes.summary: Visa for up to 90 days for business, conferences, visiting family or tourism, applied for at a Somali embassy. Needs passport valid 6+ months, two photos, flight reservation and a fee.

other: Fee not listed. Decisions can take up to a month.

routes.name: Temporary Stay Authorization (over 90 days)
routes.summary: Needed for stays longer than 90 days. Apply at a Somali embassy or consulate general.

other: Conditions and fees not published on the page read.
